data.name: Treet Corporation Limited
data.description: Treet Corporation Limited was incorporated in Pakistan on 22 January 1977 as a Public Limited Company under the Company’s Act 1913 (now Companies Act, 2017). The principal activity of the Company is to manufacture and sell razors and razor blades along with other trading activities.
